verdict.rationale: Ultrametric does ship agent skills. `ultrametric init` writes SKILL.md files for Codex (.agents/skills) and Claude Code (.claude/skills), and a `--dry-run` previews exactly which files will be created before anything is written. That gives some ability to anticipate changes to agent behavior. However, nothing in the evidence shows what those skill files contain, or that each one states its purpose and the conditions under which it activates. Missing for 10: documented per-skill descriptions of what each skill does, documented activation/trigger conditions, a published skill catalog or reference showing SKILL.md contents, and independent corroboration.
